description: The GitHub and GitLab repositories a project is connected to: each one's id, host, path and address, whether it is the project's open source repository (with the licence its host named and when that was last confirmed), whether a token is set (never the token), whether agents may read its code, and whether a webhook is set. Also whether the project itself is open source and public, whether you may change the list, and the screen where a token is given. Any member may read it.
name: list_repositories
title: List repositories
